description: Clone a voice from real audio or video material into a project (fal.ai minimax voice-clone) — the source for lab_voice_tts and for lab_dub's voice_id+dub_text path. SYNCHRONOUS: the clone runs inside the request and can take a while to return; there is no job_id to poll. The source needs a clean speech track of workable length — too short or silent material is rejected before anything is spent. Voice cloning from real material is consent-sensitive: only clone voices you have the right to use, and the Fish Audio path requires you to say so explicitly.

einwilligung.description: Consent of the person whose voice is being uploaded. Required on the fish_audio path, which refuses without it before anything is charged. This is not the moderation gate: that one reads the label for abuse, this one asserts you are allowed to use this person's voice at all. Do not set it to be rid of the error — set it because the consent exists. Provider capabilities and prices: lab_list_models.

get_cost.description: `true` reports the price and your balance WITHOUT cloning anything and without spending quota. A clone is billed per clone (a MiniMax clone costs far more than a Fish clone — ask with get_cost) — the length of the source material does not change it, and the clone is then reusable for as many readings as you like. Not drawn from the lab_list_models catalog (that covers image and video models only); there is no model to pick here.

name.description: A label for this cloned voice, shown in lab_list_voices — needed to tell several clones of one project apart later.

project_id.description: Project id (from lab_list_projects) — positive integer as string

provider.description: Which voice house clones it. Omit to stay on the default path — an existing workflow does not change vendor just because another one exists. The choice sticks to the voice: whichever house made it is the one that later speaks with it, so lab_voice_tts has no say in this. What each house can do and what it charges is not stated here — lab_list_models carries that.

sample_audio_url.description: URL of the source audio or video the voice is cloned from. Needs a real, sufficiently long speech track — material without one is rejected before anything is spent.

name: lab_voice_clone
title: Clone Voice
